objectives.title: Objective 1: Universal access to better & efficiently managed quality healthcare services

indicators.name: Average revenue per OPD patient
indicators.definition: Average Cost per patient attending OPD in the Region
indicators.numerator: Total OPD revenue- IGF (OPD Revenue Category)
indicators.denominator: Total OPD attendance

indicators.name: Percentage change in annual revenue mobilized from all sources (real and nominal)
indicators.definition: Change in revenue mobilized from all sources in the given period compared to that mobilized in the previous year from ALL public Facilities
indicators.numerator: Total revenue mobilized from All sources in the reporting period – Total revenue mobilized from All sources over the same period in the previous year
indicators.denominator: Total revenue mobilized in the previous reporting period

indicators.name: Proportion of NHIS claims submitted on time.
indicators.definition: Total number of insurance claims submitted within two months of services being rendered per the total number of insurance claims submitted by ALL public facilities
indicators.numerator: Total number of NHIF claims submitted within two months of services being rendered by GHS public facilities.
indicators.denominator: Total number of claims NHIF claims submitted within the period by GHS Public facilities.

indicators.name: Proportion of NHIS claims rejected
indicators.definition: Total amount of NHIS claims submitted by all PUBLIC facilities that were rejected per the total NHIS claims submitted by PUBLIC facilities over the period
indicators.numerator: Total amount of rejected claims from all health facilities(Public)
indicators.denominator: Total amount of NHIS claims submitted by ALL public facilities

indicators.name: Proportion of IGF spent on personal emolument
indicators.definition: The total amount of internally generated funds spent on personal emolument relative to the total internally generated funds received
indicators.numerator: The total amount of Internally generated funds spent on personal emolument
indicators.denominator: Total amount from Internally Generated Funds

indicators.name: Proportion of Goods and services budget allocated to health research activities
indicators.definition: Total amount of health budget (goods and services) allocated to research relative to the total health budget (goods and services) - all BMCs
indicators.numerator: Total amount of budget allocated to research
indicators.denominator: Total health budget(goods and services)

indicators.name: Percentage of Quarterly Internal Audits reports available (Sub Districts)
indicators.definition: This measures the coverage of quarterly internal audits reports submitted by Sub districts. It is an indication of availability of Quarterly Internal Audits reports at Sub District level. Since it is quarterly reports the total report is the number of sub districts and internal audit reports multiply by three (3*) exclude forth quarter. Check if Audit report is of standardized format
indicators.numerator: Total number of Quarterly Internal Audits report available (Sub Districts)
indicators.denominator: Total number of expected quarterly internal audit reports (Sub Districts)

indicators.name: Percentage of internal and external audits recommendations implemented
indicators.definition: This assess the coverage of internal and external audit recommendations implemented. It serves as evidence of implementation of recommendations of internal and external audits.
indicators.numerator: Total number of internal and external audit recommendations implemented
indicators.denominator: Total number of internal and external audit recommendations

indicators.name: Percentage of DHDs Districts with Budgets for Goods and Services captured into PBMIS
indicators.definition: Percentage of Districts with their Budgets for Goods and Services entered into PBMIS
indicators.numerator: Total number of Districts with Budget of Goods and services captured into PBMIS
indicators.denominator: Total number of Districts per region

indicators.name: Family planning Acceptor rate
indicators.definition: The number of women in reproductive age group who are using modern contraceptives relative to the total number of women in reproductive age group(15-49 years)
indicators.numerator: Total number of women in reproductive age group who are using any modern family planning method
indicators.denominator: Total number of women in the reproductive age group

indicators.name: Total estimated protection by contraceptive methods supplied (Couple Year Protection (CYP) for long term
indicators.definition: The estimated protection provided by family planning (FP) services during a one-year period, based upon the volume of all long term contraceptives sold or distributed free of charge to clients during that period
indicators.numerator: The sum of all the CYPs long term of all the contraceptives sold or distributed free of charge to clients
indicators.calculation: SUM (CYP of all long term devices)

indicators.name: Proportion of deliveries attended by trained health workers
indicators.definition: Total number of deliveries that were attended by a trained health worker relative to the estimated total number of deliveries
indicators.numerator: Total number of deliveries attended by a trained health worker
indicators.denominator: Total number of deliveries (pregnancies)

indicators.name: Proportion of newborns receiving postnatal care (PNC) within 48 hours from birth
indicators.definition: Total number of newborn babies who were seen for postnatal care within the first 48hours relative to the total estimated deliveries
indicators.numerator: Total number of newborn babies who were seen for postnatal care within the first 48 hours
indicators.denominator: Total deliveries

indicators.name: Proportion of mothers who made at least four ANC visits
indicators.definition: Total number of pregnant women making the 4th visit to antenatal relative to the total antenatal registrants
indicators.numerator: Total number of pregnant women making their fourth antenatal visit
indicators.denominator: Total number of antenatal registrants

indicators.name: The proportion of children due for Measles-Rubella 2 receiving LLIN
indicators.definition: Total number of children under five years of age due for measles Rubella 2 given LLIN at CWC relative to the Total number of children under five years
indicators.numerator: Total number of children given LLINs
indicators.denominator: Total number of children under five years

indicators.name: Percentage of babies breastfeeding within 1hr after delivery
indicators.definition: Percentage of newborns breastfed within 1 hour of birth in a specified period
indicators.numerator: Total number of newborns breastfed within 1 hour of birth
indicators.denominator: Total number of live babies in specified time period

indicators.name: Physician Assistant to population ratio
indicators.definition: Total population served by one Physician Assistant
indicators.numerator: Total population
indicators.denominator: Total number of Physician Assistants (public sector)
indicators.source: Human Resource Department/DHIMS2 for the population

indicators.name: Nurse to population ratio
indicators.definition: Total population served by one nurse (both proffessional and auxillary excluding midwives) - includes CHN, ER
indicators.numerator: Total population
indicators.denominator: Total number of nurses (public sector)
indicators.source: Human Resource Department/DHIMS2 for the population

indicators.name: Midwife to Women in Fertility Age (WIFA) population ratio
indicators.definition: Total population served by one midwife
indicators.numerator: Total population of women in fertility age(15-49years)
indicators.denominator: Total number of midwives (public sector)
indicators.source: Human Resource Department/DHIMS2 for the population

indicators.name: Percentage of new vehicles with valid comprehensive insurance policy and road worthy certificates
indicators.definition: Percentage of new vehicles up to 5yrs with valid comprehensive insurance policy and road worthy certificates
indicators.numerator: Number of new vehicles up to 5 yrs with valid comprehensive insurance policy and road worthy certificate
indicators.denominator: Number of new vehicles

indicators.name: Proportion of health facilities with equipment Inventory
indicators.definition: Number of health facilities with equipment inventory relative to the total number of health facilities
indicators.numerator: Number of Health Facilities with equipment Inventory
indicators.denominator: Total number of Health facilities
indicators.source: Asset Register (Updated and signed by RDHS)

indicators.name: eLMIS(GhiLMIS) capacity utilization rate
indicators.definition: This indicator measures the percentage of facilities onboarded on an eLMIS (GhiLMIS) platform that used the system for ordering, receipt, and consumption of products within a specified period. The criteria for capacity utilization require onboarded facilities to conduct all the three basic logistics functions using the system. The denominator for this indicator is the total number of onboarded facilities while the numerator represents facilities that met the established criteria.
indicators.numerator: Number of facilities that used GhiLMIS to conduct all the three basic logistics functions
indicators.denominator: Number of onboarded facilities

indicators.name: Percentage of completeness of new entries in Human Resource Management Information System (HRMIS)
indicators.definition: This measures the coverage of completeness of new entries in Human Resource Management Information System (HRMIS) - Payroll system for processing of salaries of new entrants employees who assumed duty
indicators.numerator: Number of new entrants keyed into HRMIS
indicators.denominator: Total number of new entrants who assumed duty

indicators.name: Percentage of completeness of Financial Returns in DHIMS2
indicators.definition: This measures the coverage of completeness of Financial Returns in DHIMS2
indicators.numerator: Total number of financial reports completed in DHIMS2
indicators.denominator: Total number of expected Financial Reports I DHIMS2

indicators.name: Percentage of medication therapy discrepancies/errors identified and resolved (Hospitals, Polyclinics and Health Centres)
indicators.definition: As a quality indicator it measures the coverage of medication therapy discrepancies/errors identified and resolved - provide description of medications
indicators.numerator: Total number of medication therapy discrepancies/errors resolved
indicators.denominator: Total number of medication therapy discrepancies identified

indicators.name: Midwife to WIFA population geographical equity index
indicators.definition: Equitable distribution of Midwives by districts in the region
indicators.numerator: Midwife to WIFA ratio for the best performing District
indicators.denominator: Midwife to WIFA ratio for the worst performing district

indicators.name: Physician population geographical equity index
indicators.definition: The extent to which physicians’ distribution by districts in the region is equitable
indicators.numerator: Physician population ratio in the best performing district
indicators.denominator: Physician population ratio in the worst performing district

indicators.name: Nurse population geographical equity index
indicators.definition: The extent to which nurses’ distribution by districts in the region is equitable
indicators.numerator: Nurses population ratio in the best performing district
indicators.denominator: Nurses population ratio in the worst performing district

indicators.name: Proportion of functional Community-Based Health Planning and Services (CHPS) zones
indicators.definition: The number of functional CHPS zones relative to the number of demarcated CHPS zones in the region for the given period
indicators.numerator: Total Number of functional CHPS zones
indicators.denominator: Total number of demarcated CHPS zones
indicators.source: DHIMS2 (Use 4th Quarter Report of 2022 to get this figure-it is a replacement variable)

indicators.name: Proportion of Proposed Network of Practise establised by Districts
indicators.definition: Number of NOP establised relative to the total number of proposed NOP by the region. The percentage of networks per districts per Sub District - Thirty (30) percent of Sub Districts in the District per year
indicators.numerator: Total number of NOP establised by the District per year
indicators.denominator: Total number of Proposed NOP by the Districts per year

indicators.name: Percentage of Sub-Districts implementing Community Score card
indicators.definition: This measures the coverag of community score card by Sub-Districts
indicators.numerator: Total number of Sub-Districts implementing Community Score card
indicators.denominator: Total number of Sub-Districts in the region

indicators.name: Percentage of Policy Dissemenated at District Level
indicators.definition: This measures the Policy Dissemenation Coverage at District level. This is useful to assess how many GHS policies are dissemenated every year. At most four GHS policies are to be disseminated every quarter.
indicators.numerator: Total number of policies dissemenated per District
indicators.denominator: Total number of policies to be dissemenated

indicators.name: Skilled delivery geographical equity index
indicators.definition: Supervised delivery spread by districts in the region
indicators.numerator: Supervised delivery coverage for the worst performing District
indicators.denominator: Supervised delivery coverage for the best performing district

indicators.name: Per capita Out Patient Department (OPD) attendance
indicators.definition: The number of outpatient visits to health facilities during the period relative to the total population of the same geographical area. Health facilities include all public, private, non-governmental and community-based health facilities in which general health services are offered.
indicators.numerator: Number of visits to health facilities for ambulant care (not including immunization and ANC)
indicators.denominator: Total Population

indicators.name: Percentage adherence to procurement plan
indicators.definition: Total items procured over the period by the Regional Health Directorate that was listed in the procurement plan
indicators.numerator: Total number of items procured
indicators.denominator: Total number of items Planned procured
indicators.source: Procurement plan, Summary of items procured-LPO

indicators.name: Proportion of planned Integrated Districts supervisory visits undertaken
indicators.definition: Total number of integrated supervisory visits undertaken by region to the districts using standard checklist with reports written per total number of supervisions scheduled within the period
indicators.numerator: Total number of integrated supervisory visits organized with checklist( the checklist should cover all areas of district health management- Administration and Finance, Human resource Clinical care, Public Health)
indicators.denominator: Total number of scheduled visits
indicators.source: Regional Annual Programme of Work- Integrated Supervisory reports

indicators.name: Percentage of planned Data validation meetings held by District
indicators.definition: Proportion of planned monthly data validation meetings held by District Health Directorate( Data validation meetings are to be held monthly)- Evidence of minutes of meeting
indicators.numerator: Total number of monthly data validations held
indicators.denominator: Scheduled Meetings for the year (12)

indicators.name: Proportion of health facilities providing data in DHIMS2
indicators.definition: Total number of health facilities(public and private) currently reporting in DHIMS2 relative to the total number of facilities in the region
indicators.numerator: Total number of health facilities currently reporting in DHIMS2(public and private)- Using Last three months as Proxy
indicators.denominator: Total number of facilities(private and public) in the region (Please Note that the Denominator is not Facilities in DHIMS2)

indicators.name: Percentage of Sub Districts who submitted quarterly data validation reports to DDHS
indicators.definition: This measures the coverage of Sub Districts that have submitted quarterly data validation reports to District Director of Health Services (DDHS). The Sub District Data Validation Report should be signed and approved by the Sub District In-Charge
indicators.numerator: Total number of quarterly Sub District data validation reports submitted to DDHS
indicators.denominator: Total number of expected Sub District reports to be submitted to DDHS

indicators.name: Completeness of reporting by health facilities
indicators.definition: The average number of data sets received relative to the total number of data sets expected for all reporting forms
indicators.numerator: Total number of reporting forms received from all facilities in the region
indicators.denominator: Total number of reporting forms expected to be received for all forms that are being reported upon

milestone.name: All Sub District Health Centres are submitting their quarterly IGF forcast and expenditure Reports to the District Director for approval

objectives.title: Objective 2: Reduce avoidable maternal, adolescent & child deaths and disabilities

indicators.name: Proportion of facility deaths that are medically certified
indicators.definition: Total number of deaths that are medically certified with cause of death certificate and entered into the DHIMS2-COD module per the total number of deaths (aggregated) reported by facilities in the Region
indicators.numerator: Total number of deaths that are medically certified with cause of death certificate and entered into the DHIMS2-COD module
indicators.denominator: Total number of deaths aggregated reported from all facilities in the Region
indicators.source: DHIMS2-Aggregated deaths b(Statement on In-Patient)/DHIMS2-COD- Medically certified deaths

indicators.name: Incidence rate of diabetes (using OPD as proxy)
indicators.definition: Total number of NEW cases of diabetes reporting at health facilities outpatient departments during the period per the total population at risk - 18 yrs and above
indicators.numerator: Total number of NEW cases of diabetes reporting at health facilities
indicators.denominator: Total population of the Region

indicators.name: Incidence rate of Hypertension (using OPD as proxy)
indicators.definition: Total number of NEW cases of Hypertension reporting at health facilities outpatient departments during the period per the total population at risk - 18 yrs and above
indicators.numerator: Total NEW cases of Hypertension reporting at health facilities outpatient department
indicators.denominator: Total population of the Region

indicators.name: Proportion of children U5 who were measured to assess stunting
indicators.definition: Percentage of children (0-59months) who at registration had their length/height measured to assess stunting
indicators.numerator: Number of children aged 0-59 months who had their height measured at registration
indicators.denominator: Total number of children aged 0-59months registered for CWC

indicators.name: Prevalence of anaemia in pregnant women at 36 weeks of gestation
indicators.definition: Percentage of pregnant women at 36 week with haemoglobin concentration of less than 11g/dl.
indicators.numerator: Number of pregnant women with haemoglobin concentration less than 11g/dl at 36 weeks
indicators.denominator: Total number of pregnant women who had haemoglobin concentration assessed at 36 weeks

indicators.name: Percentage of Children 6-59 months receiving Routine Vitamin A
indicators.definition: Percentage of children aged 6–59 months who received two age-appropriate doses of vitamin A in the past 12 months
indicators.numerator: Number of children who received two age-appropriate doses of vitamin A supplements in the last 12 months
indicators.denominator: Number of children aged 6−59 months

indicators.name: Percentage of ANC Registrants within the First Trimester
indicators.definition: Percentage of ANC registrants registered in 1st trimester
indicators.numerator: Number of pregnant women registered in 1st trimester
indicators.denominator: Total number of Antenatal Registrants

indicators.name: Penta 3 coverage
indicators.definition: Percentage of children 0-11 months who received Penta 3 vaccine per estimated children 0-11 months
indicators.numerator: Number of children 0-11 months who received Penta 3 vaccine
indicators.denominator: Total number of estimated children 0-11 months

indicators.name: Percentante of Children under five years who are underweight
indicators.definition: Percentage of underweight (moderate and severe) children aged 0-59 months (moderate- weight-for-age below -2 standard deviations of the WHO Child Growth standards median; Severe= weight-for-age below -3 standard deviations of the WHO Child Growth Standards median)
indicators.numerator: Number of children aged 0-59months who are underweight (at registration)
indicators.denominator: Total number of children aged 0-59 months whose weights were measured at registration
indicators.source: DHIMS2/ However If survey results (DHS/MICS) is available for reporting year use Survey Data

indicators.name: Institutional all-cause mortality rate
indicators.definition: All of the deaths that occur in an institution, regardless of the cause relative to total Admissions
indicators.numerator: Total number of deaths regardless of cause
indicators.denominator: Total number of Admissions

indicators.name: Institutional Maternal Mortality Ratio per 100,000
indicators.definition: The total number of female deaths from any cause related to or aggravated by pregnancy and its management (excluding accidental or incidental causes)during pregnancy and childbirth or within 42 days of termination of pregnancy irrespective of the duration and site of the pregnancy, expressed per 100,000 live births over a specified period
indicators.numerator: Number of maternal deaths
indicators.denominator: Total number of live births

indicators.name: Institutional Neonatal Mortality Rate per 1000
indicators.definition: The probability that a child born in a specific time period will die in the first 28 completed days of life in a health facility.
indicators.numerator: The total number of children who died during the first 28 days of life in health facilities(From Maternity, Nursery, NICU and Children’s ward)
indicators.denominator: Total number of live births from health facilities

indicators.name: Still birth rate
indicators.definition: Number of stillbirths per 1000 total births. Stillbirths can occur antepartum or intra partum. For purpose of international comparisons, stillbirths are defined as fetal deaths from 28weeks to birth
indicators.numerator: Total number of fetus and infants born per year with no sign of life and born after 28weeks gestation.
indicators.denominator: Total births number

indicators.name: Institutional Malaria Under 5 Case Fatality Rate
indicators.definition: Total number of deaths in children less than five years relative to the total number of children less than five years who were admitted with malaria
indicators.numerator: Total number of children less than five years who died from malaria on admission
indicators.denominator: Total number of Children less than five years who were admitted with malaria

indicators.name: Measles-Rubella 2 coverage
indicators.definition: Percentage of children 0-11 months who received Measles Rubella 2 vaccine per estimated children 0-11 months
indicators.numerator: Number of children 0-11 months who received Measles Rubella 2 vaccine
indicators.denominator: Total number of estimated children 0-11 months

indicators.name: Percentage of maternal deaths that are audited
indicators.definition: The number of maternal deaths audited by Hospital audit Committees per 100 total maternal deaths in the facility
indicators.numerator: Total maternal deaths for which audits were conducted
indicators.denominator: Total maternal deaths

indicators.name: Proportion of Total Mortality attributed to unsafe water, unsafe sanitation and lack of hygiene (Cholera,, Typhoid fever and Paratyphoid)
indicators.definition: Total number of deaths attributed to Cholera, dysentery, Typhoid fever and diarrhea per 100 total deaths. (Would be assessed only if COD line listing is >80% of deaths in the inpatient summary sheet
indicators.numerator: Total number of deaths attributed to Cholera, dysentery, typhoid fever and diarrhea during the period ( All diseases with ICD 10 A00, A01, ,A03, A04,A06-A09, B76-77, B-79)
indicators.denominator: Total number of deaths( Medically certified with cause of death)
indicators.source: DHIMS2- COD_ Score only if 2.1 is >80%

indicators.name: Proportion of total mortality attributed to external causes (Road traffic accidents, Falls, accidental poisoning and exposure to noxious substances, Accidental drowning, other transport accidents)
indicators.definition: Total number of deaths attributed to external causes( Road traffic accidents and Home accidents) per 100 total deaths Would be assessed only if COD line listing is >80% of deaths in the inpatient summary sheet
indicators.numerator: Total number of deaths attributed to external causes (Road traffic accidents, other transport accidents Falls, accidental poisoning and exposure to noxious substances, Accidental drowning,)
indicators.denominator: Total number of deaths ( Medically certified with cause of death certificate)
indicators.source: DHIMS2- COD_ Score only if 2.1 is >80%

indicators.name: Proportion of total mortality attributed to non-communicable diseases ( Neoplasm, Circulatory and cardiac conditions, Diabetes, Chronic Obstructive respiratory diseases)
indicators.definition: Total number of deaths attributed to non-communicable diseases (Neoplasm, Circulatory and cardiac conditions, Chronic Obstructive respiratory diseases). Would be assessed only if COD line listing is >80% of deaths in the inpatient summary sheet
indicators.numerator: Total number of deaths attributed to non-communicable diseases ( Neoplasm, Circulatory and cardiac conditions, Diabetes,Chronic Obstructive respiratory diseases)
indicators.denominator: Total number of deaths ( Medically certified with cause of death certificate)
indicators.source: DHIMS2- COD_ Score only if 2.1 is >80%

milestone.name: District Maternal Mortality Audit committees established and functional

objectives.title: Objective 3: Increase access to responsive clinical and public health emergency services

indicators.name: Hospitals, Polyclinics & Health Centres (GHS/CHAG as public) providing traditional and alternate medicine
indicators.definition: Total number of Hospitals, Polyclinics & Health Centres providing traditional and alternate medicine per the total number of Hospitals, Polyclinics & Health Centres in the District
indicators.numerator: Total number of Hospitals, Polyclinics & Health Centres providing traditional and alternate medicine
indicators.denominator: Total number of Hospitals, Polyclinics & Health Centres in District

indicators.name: Average length of stay at the accident and emergency (A&E) ward of the District Hospital/Any Facility providing Inpatient care
indicators.definition: The average duration of emergency admissions (mean no. of days from admission. to discharge)
indicators.numerator: No. of client days at the emergency wards
indicators.denominator: No. of emergency discharges and death

indicators.name: Percentage Bed occupancy rate (all hospitals)
indicators.definition: The percentage of beds occupied by clients in a given period
indicators.numerator: No. of client days
indicators.denominator: No. of beds * No of days in the period

indicators.name: Proportion of hospitals (public - GHS/CHAG) with functional emergency department
indicators.definition: Total number of public hospitals in the Region with functional emergency department( Functional means having a team trained to handle emergencies and having a unit or department in the hospital that handles emergencies
indicators.numerator: Total number of hospital (public)with functional emergency departments
indicators.denominator: Total number of hospitals(public) in the region

indicators.name: Percentage of Hospitals with Functional Public Health Units
indicators.definition: Total number of hospitals with functional (has a department which is manned by someone with training in public health) public health units relative to the total number of Hospitals in the district
indicators.numerator: Total number of hospitals with functional public health units
indicators.denominator: Total number of Hospitals in District
indicators.source: District Public Health Report & Peer review reports

indicators.name: Average number of medicines prescribed per patient encounter (public facilities )
indicators.definition: Total number of medicines prescribed for the selected prescriptions
indicators.numerator: Total number of prescriptions selected
indicators.denominator: Total number of prescriptions selected

indicators.name: Percentage of encounters with an injection prescribed (public facilities)
indicators.definition: Number of prescriptions with injections prescribed
indicators.numerator: Total number of selected prescriptions
indicators.denominator: Total number of selected prescriptions

indicators.name: Percentage of medicines prescribed by generic name (public facilities)
indicators.definition: Number of medicines prescribed by generic names
indicators.numerator: Total number of medicines on selected prescriptions
indicators.denominator: Total number of medicines on selected prescriptions

indicators.name: Percentage of prescriptions with antibiotics (public facilities)
indicators.definition: Number of prescriptions with antibiotics prescribed
indicators.numerator: Total number of selected prescriptions
indicators.denominator: Total number of selected prescriptions

indicators.name: Tracer medicines availability at the District Hospital
indicators.definition: Number of tracer medicines in stock at the end of the period. Use updated tracer medicines list
indicators.numerator: Total number of tracer medicines on the list
indicators.denominator: Total number of tracer medicines on the list

indicators.name: Percentage of District Hospitals with functional Total Quality Management (TQM) Teams
indicators.definition: This measures the coverage of District Hospitals with functional QA teams
indicators.numerator: Total number of District Hospitals with TQMTs
indicators.denominator: Total number of District Hospitals

indicators.name: Proportion of attempted suicide
indicators.definition: Number of persons who attempted suicide per 100,000 Population per year
indicators.numerator: Number of persons who attempted suicide
indicators.denominator: Total Population per 100,000

indicators.name: Incidence of depression
indicators.definition: Number of new clients diagnosed with depression per 100,000 Population per year
indicators.numerator: Number of clients diagnosed with depression
indicators.denominator: Total Population per 100,000

indicators.name: Cataract surgery (Surgical) rate
indicators.definition: It is the number of cataract operations performed in a year per million population. It is a measure of quantity of cataract services.
indicators.numerator: Total Cataract operations carried out in a year
indicators.denominator: Population in millions

indicators.name: ART coverage rate
indicators.definition: Percentage of PLHIV currently receiving ART relative to the Estimated number of PLHIV
indicators.numerator: Number of PLHIV currently receiving ART
indicators.denominator: Estimated number of PLHIV

indicators.name: Viral load testing coverage rate
indicators.definition: Percentage of PLHIV tested for viral load relative to the number eligible for viral load testing
indicators.numerator: Number of PLHIV tested for viral load
indicators.denominator: Number eligible for viral load testing

indicators.name: PMTCT testing coverage rate
indicators.definition: Percentage of pregnant women attending ANC and/or who had a facility-based delivery who were tested for HIV during pregnancy or already knew they were HIV- positive. relative to the Number of pregnant women who attended ANC or had a facility- based delivery
indicators.numerator: Number of pregnant women registered for ANC who were tested for HIV during pregnancy or already knew they were HIV- positive
indicators.denominator: Number of pregnant women registered for ANC

indicators.name: TB Case fatality rate
indicators.definition: Total number of TB patients who died during the period per the total number put on treatment during the period
indicators.numerator: Total number of TB patients who died during the period
indicators.denominator: Total number of TB patients enrolled into care during the period

indicators.name: TB Case notification rate
indicators.definition: Number of new and relapse TB cases notified in a given period per 100,000 population
indicators.numerator: Number of new and relapse TB cases notified in the period
indicators.denominator: Total population for the given period

indicators.name: TB treatment success rate
indicators.definition: Percentage of TB cases successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among TB cases notified to the national health authorities during a specified period
indicators.numerator: Total Number of TB cases registered in a specified period which were successfully treated
indicators.denominator: Total number of TB cases registered in the same period.

indicators.name: Proportion of suspected malaria cases that were tested for malaria before treatment
indicators.definition: Percentage of suspected malaria cases that were confirmed before treatment using either microscopy or RDT per the total number of suspected cases
indicators.numerator: Number of suspected malaria cases confirmed before treatment
indicators.denominator: Total number of suspected malaria cases

indicators.name: Malaria mortality rate
indicators.definition: Total number of deaths attributable to malaria per 1000 population
indicators.numerator: Total number dying from malaria
indicators.denominator: Total population

indicators.name: Non- polio AFP rate
indicators.definition: Total number of non-polio acute flaccid paralysis reported relative to the total number of children under fifteen years
indicators.numerator: Total number of non-polio AFP
indicators.denominator: Children under fifteen (15yrs) of age

indicators.name: Surgical site infection rate
indicators.definition: Total Number of surgical wound Infections occurring within 10 days relative to the total number of surgeries performed
indicators.numerator: Total number of surgical wound infection occurring within 10 days post operation

indicators.name: PLHIV newly enrolled in HIV care started on TB preventive therapy

indicators.denominator: Total number of persons newly enrolled in HIV care, that is, registered in the pre-ART or ART register

indicators.name: Percentage of infants born to HIV-infected mothers who are infected

indicators.numerator: Number of babies born to HIV positive mothers who tested positive before 18 months using DNA/PCR
indicators.denominator: Total number of babies born to HIV positive mothers and testing by DNA/PCR before 18 months

indicators.name: Proportion of pregnant women tested for syphilis

indicators.numerator: Total number of pregnant women who were tested for syphilis at registration
indicators.denominator: Total number of pregnant women registered

indicators.name: Malaria incidence per 1000 population
indicators.definition: Number of confirmed reported malaria cases per 1000 persons per year
indicators.numerator: Number of confirmed malaria cases (by either microscopy or rapid diagnostic test)- (Inpatient and Outpatient)
indicators.denominator: Total population of the Region estimated for the period

indicators.name: Percentage (%) of pregnant women on Intermittent preventive treatment (at least three doses of SP) according to national policy (HMIS)
indicators.definition: This indicator assesses the proportion of pregnant women attending antenatal clinics (registrants) who received at least 3 doses of IPTp under direct observation of a health worker. In Ghana, all pregnant women are required to receive minimum of three doses and maximum of 5 doses of SP, during regularly scheduled antenatal visits under the direct observation of a health worker. This indicator assesses the extent of implementation of IPTp for programmatic decisions.
indicators.numerator: Number of pregnant women who receive IPTp3
indicators.denominator: Number of first antenatal clinic visits (registrants)

indicators.name: Case fatality rates for epidemic prone diseases (Cholera, Meningitis, Yellow fever)
indicators.definition: Total number of deaths attributed to Cholera, Meningitis, Yellow fever per total number of cases of these three conditions reported
indicators.numerator: Total number of deaths attributable to Cholera, Meningitis and Yellow Fever
indicators.denominator: Total number of cases of Cholera, Meningitis and Yellow Fever

indicators.name: Percentage of targeted population who attended wellness clinic at the District Hospital during a year
indicators.definition: This measures the coverage of number of persons (18 years and above) who have received a health check-up at a wellness clinic during the year. (District hospitals and DHA) - provide pop 18 yrs and above. Functional wellness clinic means 1. There is a designated place for wellness clinic. The place should be labelled and with directional sign 2. There is designated nurse(s) 3. The clinic has BP apparatus, Glucometer, weighing scale, tool for measuring height, register for documentation of services provided
indicators.numerator: Number of persons (18 years and above) who have received a health check-up.
indicators.denominator:
Total Population of 18 years and above in the catchment area:

indicators.name: Proportion of functional risk communication and social mobilization committee
indicators.definition:
Functional Risk communication and social mobilization committee refers to stakeholders who meet quarterly to discuss health issues affecting the Region and develop action plans and implement them.                                                                         Availability of minutes/pictures/participants list of meetings held with stakeholders.
-Availability of an action plan or implementation plan
- Evidence of action plan implemented
indicators.numerator: Number of functional risk communication and social mobilization committee
indicators.denominator: Total number of risk communication committees in the region

indicators.name: Percentage of nurses demonstrating competence in NursMid documentation at the district Hospital
indicators.definition: This shows the coverage of nurses demonstrating competence in NursMid documentation. It measures the number of nurses with requisite competencies in the standards of practice. Verify from district hospitals
indicators.numerator: Number of nurses demostrating competence in NursMid documentation
indicators.denominator: Total number of nurses trained in NursMid at district hospitals
indicators.source: NursMid report, District Hospital Clinical Care Report

indicators.name: Percentage of NursMid audit report at the District Hospital
indicators.definition: This measures the coverage of NursMid audit report at the regional hospital per year. This is to assess how often NursMid audits are conducted at regional hospital to ensure compliance with the standards of documentation. It is to identify gaps in Nursing and Midwifery documentation towards continuous quality improvement. Four (4) quarterly audit reports are expected.
indicators.numerator: Number of NursMid audit reports submitted
indicators.denominator: Number of expected NursMid Audit reports
indicators.source: NursMid audit report, District Clinical Care Report
